title: Smart warehousing
introen: Pallet racks, automated high-bay storage, mobile systems and mezzanines, with each point linked to its aisle, member and mounting reference.

title: Heritage, buildings & trees
introen: Conservation- or arborist-approved measuring points on buildings, historic members and trees.

The H310-TS380C’s ±0.01° accuracy grade supports a finer angle reference where required by the conservation plan. Use an agreed, compatible fixing and retain the member identity, axis convention and intervention history with the readings.

scenes.briefen: Include the approved attachment method, surface restrictions, access arrangements and intended monitoring period.

Interpret readings with surveys and inspections; they are not a diagnosis of structural condition or permission for occupancy.

title: Industrial equipment
introen: Rigid equipment frames and support structures compared at defined stationary or repeatable operating states.

The H310-TS380C’s ±0.01° accuracy grade supports a finer angle reference around relocation, support adjustment or foundation work. Compare the same machine condition; precision levelling, dynamic vibration and production control require their own methods.
